places.quote: the way to be healthy, wealthy, and wise, was to come to the Marshalsea
places.note: Debtors' prison; the whole passage is set inside it. Called 'the college' by its inmates.

places.normalized: Snuggery (tavern within the Marshalsea Prison, Southwark, London)
places.quote: with an awful enjoyment of the Snuggery’s resources
places.note: Inmates' tavern inside the prison; a named room, not a separate outside place.
